answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk forgery. Each newcomer posts a 50 POA bond to dock in the harbor, and it burns 5 POA per epoch unless real work tops it up. Like a juniper in dry soil, fresh identities earn trust slowly, and idle fakes fade within ten epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA against a ~900 POA pool, more than the oasis of rewards is worth. An honest agent posts once, works, and keeps an undiluted share.
